answer: Because the timing is recorded against the zephyr challenge, the jade audit can replay the vault history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 45 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3138 identities would post 1609 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
